case_number: 2025 INSC 64; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 465 OF 2019; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017
summary: Non-compliance of absorption order; family pension and post-retiral benefits claim; deceased husband's absorption w.e.f. 10.12.1985 confirmed; directions for adjudication through Registrar/Vice Chancellor; discrete enquiry mandated; family pension to be calculated from absorption date; liberty to approach High Court if dissatisfied.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petition disposed of with directions for adjudication of family pension and post-retiral benefits within specified timelines; liberty to approach High Court preserved.
